name: Hardwire Technology Company, LLC
old_description: Our skilled team specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of structured cabling systems. We ensure seamless connectivity and optimal performance through the use of top-quality copper and fiber optic cables, meticulous planning of cable pathways, and adherence to industry best practices.
about:
Hardwire Technology Company, LLC is headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, within the Twin Cities metropolitan area. The company operates as a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Women's Business Enterprise (WBE), and Small Business Enterprise (SBE) through Minnesota's Central Certification (CERT) program. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The firm provides single-source low-voltage technology solutions, specializing in the design, installation, and certification of structured cabling infrastructure using copper and fiber optic cables. Its service portfolio also includes physical security systems, voice-over-IP telephone systems (hosted PBX and SIP trunking), audiovisual solutions, TV mounting, and digital signage installation and maintenance. Hardwire manages projects from pre-construction planning through implementation and end-user training.

Its client base spans small and midsized businesses, school districts, government agencies, and regional contractors across the Upper Midwest. The company emphasizes long-term partnerships with these sectors, offering ongoing support and maintenance.

Hardwire differentiates itself through its RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) licensed specialist on staff, a credential recognized internationally for telecommunications infrastructure design. The company also cites its comprehensive project management approach, direct manufacturer relationships, and diversity certifications as key differentiators.
